```{python}
#| include: false

from pathlib import Path
import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

PROJECT_DIR = Path.cwd().resolve()
if PROJECT_DIR.name == "load":
    PROJECT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR.parent
REPO_DIR = PROJECT_DIR.parent if PROJECT_DIR.name == "alt_approach" else PROJECT_DIR
DATA_DIR = REPO_DIR / "data" / "config"
LOAD_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "load" if PROJECT_DIR.name == "alt_approach" else PROJECT_DIR / "alt_approach" / "load"
sys.path.insert(0, str(LOAD_DIR))

import jcr_update_loader as jcr

jcr.configure_logging()
sources = jcr.load_sources(DATA_DIR)
course_id = jcr.course_id_from_environment()
selected = jcr.select_course(sources, course_id)
course_register = jcr.course_register(sources)
meetings = jcr.meeting_summary(selected)

if course_id is None:
    report_title = "All JCR courses"
else:
    match = course_register.loc[course_register["course_id"].eq(course_id), "canonical_name"]
    report_title = match.iloc[0] if not match.empty else f"Course {course_id}"

readings = jcr.reading_analysis(selected, course_id=course_id)
spatial_readings = jcr.add_spatial_membership(selected, readings)
readings["discipline"] = readings["discipline"].fillna("unknown").astype("string").str.title()
readings["official_going_clean"] = readings["official_going_clean"].replace("", pd.NA)
```

# JCR GoingStick Data

## Scope and data coverage

```{python}
course_count = selected["courses"]["course_id"].nunique()
map_count = selected["maps"]["map_id"].nunique()
report_count = selected["reports"]["report_id"].nunique()
reading_count = selected["readings"]["reading_id"].nunique()
print(f"Scope: {report_title} | courses={course_count}, maps={map_count}, reports={report_count}, readings={reading_count}")

coverage = (
    meetings.groupby(["course_id", "course_name"], dropna=False)
    .agg(
        meetings=("race_date", "nunique"),
        reports=("going_report_count", "sum"),
        going_reported=("official_going_reported", "sum"),
        reading_uploaded=("race_day_goingstick_uploaded", "sum"),
    )
    .reset_index()
)
coverage.head()
```

## Meeting reporting status

```{python}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

status_column = "overall_compliance_category"
if status_column not in meetings:
    status_column = "compliance_level"
status = meetings.copy()
status[status_column] = status[status_column].fillna("Unclassified")
summary = status.groupby(["course_name", status_column]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
summary = summary.div(summary.sum(axis=1).replace(0, 1), axis=0).mul(100)
ax = summary.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, figsize=(12, 6), colormap="RdYlGn")
ax.set_title(f"Meeting reporting status — {report_title}")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Meetings (%)")
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.2)
ax.legend(title="Status", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc="upper left", frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# GoingStick measurements

## Index values by year and discipline

```{python}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.5

plot = readings.dropna(subset=["index", "year"]).copy()
plot["year"] = plot["year"].astype(int).astype(str)
disciplines = [value for value in ("Jumps", "Flat", "Unknown") if value in plot["discipline"].unique()]
if not disciplines:
    disciplines = sorted(plot["discipline"].dropna().unique())
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, max(1, len(disciplines)), figsize=(12, 5.5), squeeze=False, sharey=True)
for ax, discipline in zip(axes[0], disciplines):
    subset = plot.loc[plot["discipline"].eq(discipline)]
    if subset.empty:
        ax.set_visible(False)
        continue
    subset.boxplot(column="index", by="year", ax=ax, grid=False, patch_artist=True,
                   boxprops={"facecolor": "#4472C4", "alpha": .7})
    ax.set_title(f"{discipline}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Year")
    ax.set_ylabel("GoingStick index")
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.2)
fig.suptitle("")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Index, penetration and shear by official going

```{python}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.5

metrics = [("index", "GoingStick index"), ("penetrate", "Penetration"), ("shear", "Shear")]
plot = readings.dropna(subset=["official_going_clean"]).copy()
going_order = plot.groupby("official_going_clean")["index"].count().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10).index
plot = plot.loc[plot["official_going_clean"].isin(going_order)].copy()
plot["official_going_clean"] = pd.Categorical(plot["official_going_clean"], categories=going_order, ordered=True)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 5.5))
for ax, (metric, label) in zip(axes, metrics):
    plot.boxplot(column=metric, by="official_going_clean", ax=ax, grid=False, patch_artist=True,
                 boxprops={"facecolor": "#5B9BD5", "alpha": .75})
    ax.set_title(label)
    ax.set_xlabel("Official going")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=65, labelsize=8)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.2)
fig.suptitle("")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Spatial summaries by configured section and zone

```{python}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.5

spatial = spatial_readings.dropna(subset=["index"]).copy()
section_summary = (
    spatial.dropna(subset=["section_label"])
    .groupby(["course_id", "map_id", "map_label", "section_label"], dropna=False)
    .agg(readings=("index", "size"), mean_index=("index", "mean"), median_index=("index", "median"))
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values(["course_id", "map_id", "section_label"])
)
zone_summary = (
    spatial.dropna(subset=["zone_label"])
    .groupby(["course_id", "map_id", "map_label", "zone_label"], dropna=False)
    .agg(readings=("index", "size"), mean_index=("index", "mean"), median_index=("index", "median"))
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values(["course_id", "map_id", "zone_label"])
)
print(f"Section groups: {len(section_summary)}; zone groups: {len(zone_summary)}")
display(section_summary.head(30))
```

## Daily shear trend

```{python}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5.5

daily = readings.dropna(subset=["race_date", "shear"]).groupby(
    ["race_date", "discipline"], dropna=False
)["shear"].mean().reset_index()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 5.5))
for discipline, subset in daily.groupby("discipline", dropna=False):
    ax.plot(subset["race_date"], subset["shear"], marker="o", markersize=2,
            linewidth=1, label=str(discipline))
ax.set_title(f"Daily mean GoingStick shear — {report_title}")
ax.set_xlabel("Race date")
ax.set_ylabel("Mean shear")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.2)
ax.legend(frameon=False)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
